title: Lower-resource recomposition user with symptom caution

planFingerprint.nutritionStrategy: Use a simple dairy intolerance meal pattern built around repeatable staples, explicit avoidance of known triggers, and budget-conscious grocery choices. Example structure: yogurt-free overnight oats or eggs for breakfast, rice or potatoes with lean protein and vegetables for lunch, and a repeatable dinner bowl built around tolerated ingredients.
planFingerprint.workoutStrategy: Build a recomposition routine using bodyweight only with intensity bounded by adherence concerns. Example split: squat and split-squat work, push-up variations, hinge or bridge work, and a short core finisher, with optional walking or mobility finishers when recovery is limited.
planFingerprint.weeklySchedule: 1 lighter weekday session plus 1 more substantial weekend session across 2 total training days
planFingerprint.adherenceSupports: repeat meals, a short grocery list, clear fallback meal options, shorter weekday actions, and a weekend prep block for lower-friction adherence
warnings: This is non-clinical planning support, not diagnosis or treatment.
